```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(worldmet)   # ✅ This is the missing one


# Load temperature data
daily_max_temps <- read_csv("daily_max_july2024.csv") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# Enhanced static plot
ggplot(daily_max_temps, aes(x = date, y = tmax_F)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(color = "#D55E00", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = tmax_F), vjust = -1, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Seattle Daily High Temperatures (°F)",
    subtitle = "July 2024 — Seattle-Tacoma Airport",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Max Temperature (°F)"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "3 days") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r}
daily_multi <- read_csv("daily_multi_july2024.csv")
datatable(
  daily_multi,
  options = list(pageLength = 10),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```


```{r}

daily_multi <- read_csv("daily_multi_july2024.csv")
map_day <- daily_multi %>% filter(date == as.Date("2024-07-10"))

# Merge location info
stations <- getMeta()
map_data <- map_day %>%
  left_join(
    stations %>% transmute(station = station, lat = latitude, lon = longitude),
    by = "station"
  )
leaflet(map_data) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~lon, ~lat,
    label = ~paste0(station, ": ", tmax_F, "°F"),
    color = ~colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = map_data$tmax_F)(tmax_F),
    radius = ~(tmax_F - 70)/2,  # size by temp
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    stroke = FALSE
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = map_data$tmax_F),
    values = map_data$tmax_F,
    title = "High Temp (°F)"
  )

```
